risks_and_observations.issue: No root module terraform block with required_version
modules_affected: Root modules in both Azure and GCP templates
risks_and_observations.impact: Any OpenTofu version >=1.0 may be used, risking backward/forward incompatibilities
risks_and_observations.recommendation: Add terraform block with required_version constraint at root

risks_and_observations.impact: Providers are not locked - each init may pull different versions
risks_and_observations.recommendation: Run 'tofu init' and commit lock files to repository

risks_and_observations.impact: DIAL addon has stricter constraint than main modules
risks_and_observations.recommendation: Standardize provider versions across all modules

modules_affected: GCP modules: gke, network, service-account, storage
risks_and_observations.impact: No explicit provider version constraints in most GCP modules
risks_and_observations.recommendation: Add explicit terraform blocks with required_providers to all modules

risks_and_observations.impact: Deployment depends on locally installed OpenTofu version
risks_and_observations.recommendation: Use Docker image with pinned OpenTofu version for consistent deployments

risks_and_observations.impact: Latest tls provider will be used
risks_and_observations.recommendation: Add version constraint like ~> 4.0 to tls provider

immediate_actions.details: Create/update opentofu/azure/template/main.tf and opentofu/gcp/template/main.tf with required_version constraint
Run 'tofu init' in template directories and commit .opentofu.lock.hcl files
immediate_actions.command: cd opentofu/azure/template && tofu init && git add .opentofu.lock.hcl

immediate_actions.details: Review and align all provider version constraints across modules
immediate_actions.example: azurerm: all use ~> 4.0, dial addon aligns with ~> 4.0

medium_term_improvements: Add explicit provider constraints to all modules (currently some implicitly inherit)
Use terraform workspace to manage multiple deployments
Create centralized versions.tf at root level for all provider requirements
Use GitHub Actions or similar to pin OpenTofu version in CI/CD
long_term_strategy: Migrate to module registry or Terraform Cloud for version management
Implement semantic versioning for modules (v1.0.0, v1.1.0, etc.)
Establish provider upgrade policy (e.g., upgrade monthly)
Document compatibility matrix: OpenTofu version × Provider versions
